constraints.description: Federal flat-rate withholding on supplemental wages
constraints.evidence_quote: Withhold a flat 22% (no other percentage allowed).
constraints.interpretation: RSU vest income is paid as supplemental wages (interpretation), so shares are withheld at this rate; tax above it is paid later in cash. Applies to the first $1 million of supplemental wages in a year.

constraints.evidence_quote: If a supplemental wage payment, together with other supplemental wage payments made to the employee during the calendar year, exceeds $1 million, the excess is subject to withholding at 37% (or the highest rate of income tax for the year).
constraints.interpretation: Mandatory only on supplemental wages above $1 million. It is the ceiling for the 'raise RSU withholding' prevention option, which needs the employer to withhold above the 22% flat rate (see the RSU award agreement).
